Definition: a fissure (of rocks); also a bough (as subdivided)
BiblicalUsage: In Isaiah we find çâʻîyph, the word for a fissure of rock, or a bough. Plainly used, and no mystery about what it means.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çâʻîyph is worth a moment of attention, and I think you will see why when you read the verse.
